si_4_title: Individual-level deviations from normative brain morphology in violence, psychosis, and psychopathy

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: TOP (Thematically Organized Psychosis), sTOP (Forensic Psychiatry study), uTOP (Youth-TOP study), and STROKEMRI (Stroke MRI study) were the primary sources for the local participants (calibration and clinical samples). A pre-trained normative model was used, which was trained on 58,835 individuals from 82 sites (Rutherford et al., 2022).

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: TOP, uTOP, and STROKEMRI provided local healthy controls for calibration (n=998) and case-control matching (n=196). Patients were recruited from sTOP (SSD-V, nonSSD-V), TOP, and uTOP (SSD-NV). The pre-trained model (58,835 individuals) defined the normative distribution.

SSD-NV ..., and (4) healthy controls (HC, n = 196) matched by age and scanner.

model-1.model-name: Normative model of brain morphology (Area, Thickness, Volume)

dc_3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norm.detail: The models for cortical area, thickness, and subcortical volume were pre-trained on a dataset of 58,835 individuals (Train-phase). For application to the local study, the model was fine-tuned using a calibration set of 998 healthy controls. Additionally, 196 matched healthy controls were used as a control group for clinical comparisons. The overall healthy control count is 58,835 (pre-training) + 998 (calibration) + 196 (matched controls) = 60,029.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_model.detail: The pre-training dataset (58,835 individuals) ranged from 2 to 100 years of age. The specific mean and SD for the entire healthy control pool (pre-training + calibration + matched controls) are not reported. The age-matched controls (n=196) had a mean age of 31.9 (SD 10.0), ranging from 15.7 to 70.9 years. The training set age range is explicitly stated as 2-100.
